## BAVARIA YACHTS – 45 Years of Yachting

BAVARIA YACHTS has been a manufacturer of innovative series yachts for 45 years. Over 42,000 sailing
yachts and motorboats have been built on the 200,000 m² site since 1978.

What makes us special and what we especially show greatness in, is the experience of our employees.
We deliver perfection, for which about 700 employees give their best. 

Every day, with every move - We are BAVARIA!

# Naviguer vers la neutralité carbone

Fountaine Pajot est aujourd’hui une structure ambitieuse, fière de son ancrage local et de son
histoire, capable d’ajuster son cap pour s’adapter aux enjeux du monde à venir. De nouvelles
générations nous rejoignent et nous apportent aujourd’hui un nouveau souffle. Ensemble, construisons
le futur de la navigation, le bateau de demain !

## Une signature mondiale

Concepteurs et constructeurs de bateaux depuis 1976, passionnés de la mer, chez Fountaine Pajot nous
développons un savoir-faire unique afin de donner naissance à des bateaux performants et
confortables, marins et innovants, tournés vers une navigation plus durable.

Avec l’aide de sa plateforme collaborative ODSea Lab, le Groupe Fountaine Pajot travaille sur une
production d’énergie embarquée vertueuse et autonome
Nouveaux enjeux, nouveau cap

Inspirés par la passion de la voile et l’amour des océans, Fountaine Pajot combine depuis plus d’un
demi-siècle vision, savoir-faire et innovation pour concevoir le meilleur des bateaux.

# Naviguer vers la neutralité carbone

Fountaine Pajot est aujourd’hui une structure ambitieuse, fière de son ancrage local et de son
histoire, capable d’ajuster son cap pour s’adapter aux enjeux du monde à venir. De nouvelles
générations nous rejoignent et nous apportent aujourd’hui un nouveau souffle. Ensemble, construisons
le futur de la navigation, le bateau de demain !

## Une signature mondiale

Concepteurs et constructeurs de bateaux depuis 1976, passionnés de la mer, chez Fountaine Pajot nous
développons un savoir-faire unique afin de donner naissance à des bateaux performants et
confortables, marins et innovants, tournés vers une navigation plus durable.

Avec l’aide de sa plateforme collaborative ODSea Lab, le Groupe Fountaine Pajot travaille sur une
production d’énergie embarquée vertueuse et autonome
Nouveaux enjeux, nouveau cap

# BALI, THE NEW ART OF LIVING

## Discover our wide range of Catamarans

[
Access all models][38]
[Tracé filaire du bateau Bali 70 pieds]
[BALI CATSPACE-Trace-Silhouette catamaran 40 pieds]
[Bali 5.2 silhouette]

New

### Bali 7.0

73.11 Foot

24757 sq ft

[Discover the Bali 7.0][39]

## The Bali door, open to the world

BALI models have revolutionised the approach to yachting, with one key word: openness. The BALI DOOR
offers a unique experience on board, freeing up that BALI OPEN SPACE to the sea. The outside invites
itself inside, and the living space connects with the sea. Signature innovations, the Bali Door and
the Open Space create new living areas.

[porte bali catamaran ouvert au mouillage, et personnes buvant un verre de vin]

## Fully-decked forward cockpit

The rigid foredeck is a BALI creation. Designed to provide a unique usable deck area, it is home to
a huge lounge space and sunbathing areas in an ideal position facing the sea, while remaining
protected from the spray and sun if desired, thanks to a removable awning. Being fully-decked gives
the hull incomparable strength, providing excellent seaworthiness and making it easier to move
around the boat.

[femme bronzant sur le pont avant rigide d'un catamarans]

## Rooftop on the sea

With the exception of the Bali Catsmart, all Bali models feature a flybridge. In keeping with the
spirit of the brand, these spaces are designed as veritable Rooftops on the sea, so you can enjoy
the sun, the sea and your loved ones in comfort, and helm with maximum visibility.

[femme et sa fille sur le rooftop sur-la-mer]

## It’s words that count, and they speak for us

> “We love the BALI door. It would be impossible for us to go back to a boat without this solution.
> We can choose to be inside or outside depending on the weather at the touch of a button. It's
> magical, really!”
> 
> Torkil Færø · Bali 4.6

> “We fell in love with the Bali 4.2 and especially the Bali concept, which offers an absolutely
> wonderful, friendly and airy Open Space for our family with our two children.”
> 
> Sandra and Gabriel · Bali 4.2

> “The boat is very easy to handle and the system in place on the 4.8 allows perfect adjustment and
> stability of the boom in bad weather without the use of an additional boom preventer.”
> 
> Claude and Brigitte · Bali 4.8

[photo de mains avec gants de latex ]

## 40 years of experience in the design and manufacture of catamarans

Innovation is at the heart of the Catana Group’s DNA, all focusing on the experience of sailing. The
group, which specialises in the design and manufacture of catamarans, benefits from 40 years'
experience, the know-how of the CATANA range and the expertise of its teams.

## The Bali door, open to the world

BALI models have revolutionised the approach to yachting, with one key word: openness. The BALI DOOR
offers a unique experience on board, freeing up that BALI OPEN SPACE to the sea. The outside invites
itself inside, and the living space connects with the sea. Signature innovations, the Bali Door and
the Open Space create new living areas.

[porte bali catamaran ouvert au mouillage, et personnes buvant un verre de vin]

## Fully-decked forward cockpit

The rigid foredeck is a BALI creation. Designed to provide a unique usable deck area, it is home to
a huge lounge space and sunbathing areas in an ideal position facing the sea, while remaining
protected from the spray and sun if desired, thanks to a removable awning. Being fully-decked gives
the hull incomparable strength, providing excellent seaworthiness and making it easier to move
around the boat.

[femme bronzant sur le pont avant rigide d'un catamarans]

## Rooftop on the sea

With the exception of the Bali Catsmart, all Bali models feature a flybridge. In keeping with the
spirit of the brand, these spaces are designed as veritable Rooftops on the sea, so you can enjoy
the sun, the sea and your loved ones in comfort, and helm with maximum visibility.

[femme et sa fille sur le rooftop sur-la-mer]

### Powering Performance.
### Navigating Innovation.

Power. Precision. Peace of Mind.
* ## Certified Expertise
  
  With over 17 years in the industry, we bring deep technical knowledge and hands-on experience to
  every project. As certified Victron and Mastervolt integrators, we ensure every system is
  installed to the highest standards—meeting ABYC, CE, and OEM specifications.
* ## Designed for Sail & Power
  
  While we specialize in catamarans, our expertise extends across all vessel types. From multihull
  performance cruisers to classic monohulls, we design and install systems that align with your
  boat’s architecture, energy demands, and offshore goals.
* ## Trusted by Pros
  
  From private owners to charter fleets and high-performance cruisers, we’ve delivered solutions
  across the East Coast and Caribbean. Our reputation is built on reliability, transparent
  communication, and long-term system performance at sea.

[A modern black and white yacht floating on calm blue water near rocky shores with green trees and a
partly cloudy sky.]

At **Bluewater Yacht Tech**, we engineer elite electrical, navigation, and hybrid energy systems
designed exclusively for catamarans. Whether you're refitting with full lithium power, installing
solar arrays, or upgrading to the latest in hybrid propulsion and navigation technology—we deliver
performance-driven solutions for serious sailors.

Founded by **Rafael Escobar**, a seasoned marine systems expert with over **17 years of
experience**, Bluewater Yacht Tech combines technical mastery with innovation. Rafael has led
complex refits on high-performance vessels, partnered with industry-leading OEMs, and earned a
reputation for **precision, quality, and next-level system integration**.

Based in **Fort Lauderdale**, we proudly serve yacht owners and captains across the **East Coast and
Caribbean**, helping them sail smarter, cleaner, and farther.

## ABOUT US

[ Learn more ][17]

## Specialized Marine Solutions

#### High-Performance Marine Electrical Refits

We design and install complete DC and AC systems customized for modern catamarans. Whether you're
upgrading your alternators, breakers, shore power, or distribution panels, we deliver clean,
reliable power integration that meets ABYC and CE standards.

#### Navigation & Electronics Upgrades

As certified Victron and Mastervolt integrators, we install state-of-the-art lithium battery banks,
solar arrays, and hybrid propulsion solutions. Our systems maximize energy storage and efficiency
while reducing fossil fuel dependency.

#### Hybrid & Lithium Power Systems

From touchscreen chartplotters to radar, sonar, AIS, and onboard WiFi, we provide seamless
navigation packages using Raymarine, Garmin, B&G, and more — all configured for intuitive control
and optimal performance.

Proven Products. Precision Install.
* [Interior of a catamaran with an open battery compartment showing blue Victron batteries, wiring,
  and electronic components, with seating and a wooden shelf nearby.]
  
  ## Lithium Battery Systems
  
  We offer high-capacity lithium solutions from Epoch, Victron, and Mastervolt — fully integrated
  with smart BMS and remote monitoring. Engineered for longevity, efficiency, and safety in the
  marine environment.
* [Blue Water Yacht Teck boat dock with solar equipment and workers preparing for maintenance or
  installation, under a white canopy with boats moored alongside.]
  
  ## Solar Energy & Charging
  
  Our custom solar setups range from arch-mounted to deck-integrated designs, optimized for
  catamaran geometry. Coupled with MPPT charge controllers and DC-DC charging, your energy
  independence is just a sunrise away.
* [Blue Water Yacht Tech Garmin navigation display installed on a Catamaran showing a map of the
  southeastern United States, Caribbean, and parts of Central America, with a flight path over the
  Gulf of Mexico.]
  
  ## Navigation Technology
  
  We install and configure chartplotters, radar, sonar, VHF, AIS, and full NMEA 2000 networks —
  creating connected navigation systems that give captains complete confidence offshore.

## Contact Us

**Ready to upgrade, maintain, or stormproof your vessel?**

From complete electrical refits and hybrid propulsion to plumbing, watermakers, maintenance, and
hurricane prep—we offer full-service marine systems support tailored to your boat’s needs.

Fill out the form below to tell us more about your vessel and project.
We’ll be in touch to schedule a consultation and get started.

# Outremer, leader mondial de la grande croisière

Notre mission est de permettre à chacun, marin chevronné ou non, de réaliser son rêve de petit ou
grand voyage à la voile dans le respect des océans et en leur apportant sécurité, sérénité et
accompagnement à chaque étape du projet, à bord d’un catamaran marin et confortable, conçu pour
durer.

[ ][50]
[ ][51]
[ ][52]
[Découvrez la gamme][53]

### The intelligent voyager, Built to go far

Vous n’aurez plus à choisir entre confort et performances, l’Outremer 48 réunit toutes les qualités.
En moins de 15 m de longueur, il offre un espace jamais vu, une vision sur 360° ininterrompue, des
espaces de rangements impressionnants tout en conservant le niveau de performances et de sécurité
qui ont bâti la légende d’Outremer.

[Découvrir l'Outremer 48][54]

### Outremer Ready : votre programme personnalisé

Acheter un Outremer, c’est décider de partir à l’aventure. Outremer Ready est notre programme
d’accompagnement en 4 étapes qui rend ce départ possible, sereinement. Du rêve initial jusqu’au
retour de voyage, nous vous guidons pas à pas : se préparer, progresser, partir, revenir. À chaque
étape, vous montez en compétence et gagnez en confiance, pour prendre le large en toute maîtrise.

[Parcourir Outremer Ready][55]

### Partir autour du monde en 2027 ? Rejoignez notre prochain rallye

Destinés aux propriétaires Outremer et aux propriétaires des autres bateaux du groupe Grand Large
Yachting : les rallies réunissent des dizaines de passionnés qui naviguent ensemble à travers le
globe. Rejoignez dès maintenant le prochain rallye qui part en 2027 !

[En savoir plus sur nos Rallyes][56]

### Louer un Outremer

Vivez la navigation hauturière à bord d’un catamaran Outremer grâce à notre service de location avec
équipage. Que vous souhaitiez tester un modèle avant un achat ou simplement découvrir le plaisir du
large, explorez les Bahamas ou la Grèce aux côtés de skippers certifiés. Une expérience authentique
pour découvrir l’esprit Outremer.

[Je veux louer un Outremer][57]

### Une année sabbatique en mer à bord d’un Outremer 45

Vivez douze mois de liberté à bord d’un catamaran d’exception, grâce à une offre de leasing courte
durée incluant formation et services. Une manière simple et inspirante de réaliser votre rêve de
grande croisière, sans attendre d’être propriétaire.

[Découvrir l'offre exclusive][58]

## Rejoignez la communauté

### Des navigateurs passionnés

Avec une flotte de près de 450 catamarans autour du monde, Outremer forme une communauté
exceptionnelle : celle des aventuriers hédonistes.

Pour cultiver ce lien avec nos navigateurs, nous organisons régulièrement des évènements tels que
l’Outremer Cup, et proposons des outils facilitant le projet de voyage comme le groupe Facebook des
propriétaires et un blog d’informations techniques.

un voyage plus long dans le Pacifique. Comme d’habitude, le confort, l’espace, la rapidité, la
sécurité, la maniabilité et le service après-vente d’Outremer rendent la vie au paradis plus
paradisiaque..

L'image du catamaran c'est un peu la caravane flottante. Et puis on a essayé les Outremer, on s'est
rendu compte que ce n'était pas du tout ça. Le côté marin, sportif... Ca avance ! Donc on s'est
assez vite décidé [pour un Outremer].

### Une année sabbatique en mer à bord d’un Outremer 45

Vivez douze mois de liberté à bord d’un catamaran d’exception, grâce à une offre de leasing courte
durée incluant formation et services. Une manière simple et inspirante de réaliser votre rêve de
grande croisière, sans attendre d’être propriétaire.

[Découvrir l'offre exclusive][58]

## Rejoignez la communauté

### Des navigateurs passionnés

Avec une flotte de près de 450 catamarans autour du monde, Outremer forme une communauté
exceptionnelle : celle des aventuriers hédonistes.

Pour cultiver ce lien avec nos navigateurs, nous organisons régulièrement des évènements tels que
l’Outremer Cup, et proposons des outils facilitant le projet de voyage comme le groupe Facebook des
propriétaires et un blog d’informations techniques.

[En savoir plus][59]
OUTREMER 4X NO LIMIT, LOICK PEYRON
On sent qu'un travail a été fait sur le poids. [...] La légèreté ce n'est pas seulement une question
de performance mais de sécurité sur ces bateaux-là.
OUTREMER 51 KOKO KIWI, MARK
Outremer a créé avec succès un bateau qui englobe vitesse, simplicité, qualité et sécurité. Pour
nous, cela représente de bons moments, de beaux endroits et de belles expériences en famille.
OUTREMER 55 GREATCIRCLE, MARIJKE ET MARK
Ce qui nous a poussé vers Outremer c'est le fait que ce soit un chantier à taille humaine, où l'on
se sent vraiment inclus dans tout le processus d'achat. De plus, le lancement d'un nouveau modèle
(le 55') et d'un rallye prometteur (le GLYWO) a vraiment coché toutes nos cases !
OUTREMER 5X KKOUM, KELLY ET JEROME
Heureux propriétaires d'un 51' pour un tour de l'Atlantique en 2016, nous sommes passés à un 5X pour
un voyage plus long dans le Pacifique. Comme d’habitude, le confort, l’espace, la rapidité, la
sécurité, la maniabilité et le service après-vente d’Outremer rendent la vie au paradis plus
paradisiaque..
OUTREMER 45 LOUSTIC, NANCY ET FREDERIC
L'image du catamaran c'est un peu la caravane flottante. Et puis on a essayé les Outremer, on s'est
rendu compte que ce n'était pas du tout ça. Le côté marin, sportif... Ca avance ! Donc on s'est
assez vite décidé [pour un Outremer].

## Dreaming of Catamaran Ownership? 



Most catamaran buyers walk into this market with a dream in one hand and a budget in the other — and
discover too late that neither was enough.


Years of YouTube, a helpful broker, a survey on the day — it feels like enough. But the broker works
for the seller, the survey is limited in time and scope, and the market is full of boats listed at
exactly the moment their hidden costs become someone else's problem.


Too many buyers overpay, get ambushed by first-year costs, and find themselves deep in a refit and
upgrade cycle they never budgeted for. Not because they weren't careful. Because nobody told them
what to look for.

You've earned this dream. Let's make sure the market doesn't take it from you.

 

 


 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 


 

 

 

 

 

 

 


23,000+ transactions. Decades of asset evaluation experience. Now exclusively in your courner. 


When "Passed Survey" Isn't.....


When I was shopping for my own boat, I researched a model that kept coming up — clean listings, good
prices, lots of space and a great layout. I was tempted. But I couldn't find reliable information on
how it aged. No track record on the issues that show up years 7–10. I walked away.


A few years later I found an owner who had bought one. It passed the first survey. Then, after
purchase, two more surveys still couldn't identify or highlight the problems now showing. By the
time it surfaced, he was on his own to diagnose and fix it himself. He's since shared publicly that
putting it right cost him $180,000.


That's not one surveyor's mistake. That's proof surveyors — even good ones — aren't equipped to
catch model-specific issues. It's exactly the risk my pre-offer assessment process is built to catch
early and mitigate — not eliminate entirely, but stack the odds in your favor before you're
financially committed.


> "I am so glad you pushed me to get the owner and surveyor to assess the steering systems further —
> and by doing so found a $12,000 problem that would have been missed."
> Leopard 48 buyer
> 

> "'Bluewater ready' is marketing jargon. " Robin, Lagoon 380 Owner

## Dreaming of Catamaran Ownership? 



Most catamaran buyers walk into this market with a dream in one hand and a budget in the other — and
discover too late that neither was enough.


Years of YouTube, a helpful broker, a survey on the day — it feels like enough. But the broker works
for the seller, the survey is limited in time and scope, and the market is full of boats listed at
exactly the moment their hidden costs become someone else's problem.


Too many buyers overpay, get ambushed by first-year costs, and find themselves deep in a refit and
upgrade cycle they never budgeted for. Not because they weren't careful. Because nobody told them
what to look for.

You've earned this dream. Let's make sure the market doesn't take it from you.

 

 


 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 


 

 

 

 

 

 

 


23,000+ transactions. Decades of asset evaluation experience. Now exclusively in your courner. 


When "Passed Survey" Isn't.....


When I was shopping for my own boat, I researched a model that kept coming up — clean listings, good
prices, lots of space and a great layout. I was tempted. But I couldn't find reliable information on
how it aged. No track record on the issues that show up years 7–10. I walked away.


A few years later I found an owner who had bought one. It passed the first survey. Then, after
purchase, two more surveys still couldn't identify or highlight the problems now showing. By the
time it surfaced, he was on his own to diagnose and fix it himself. He's since shared publicly that
putting it right cost him $180,000.


That's not one surveyor's mistake. That's proof surveyors — even good ones — aren't equipped to
catch model-specific issues. It's exactly the risk my pre-offer assessment process is built to catch
early and mitigate — not eliminate entirely, but stack the odds in your favor before you're
financially committed.

> and by doing so found a $12,000 problem that would have been missed."

## About

Hi, I'm Peter Rollo.

If you're dreaming about catamaran ownership, you're about to make one of the biggest lifestyle and
financial decisions of your life.

 

I've spent 25 years evaluating and negotiating used assets at high volume. Then I bought a Leopard
48, lived aboard, and cruised 12,000+ nautical miles with my partner and young son. I know what
these boats cost to buy, own, refit upgrade and sail.


My mission is simple: help future catamaran owners make better decisions before the expensive
mistakes happen.


I represent buyers, not sellers. No broker commissions. No seller affiliations. Just independent
advice, practical education and complete confidentiality.

At Catamaran, we work tirelessly to ensure we exceed our customers' expectations in everything we

Our commitment to creating a safe work environment is evident in everything we do. Our employees are

capacity to complete projects under even the tightest deadlines. In addition, our QA/QC programs are
designed to ensure each project is completed to the highest standards the first time, without latent
defects.
Efficient & Consistent Performance
Catamaran's investment in state-of-the-art equipment combined with our stable, qualified craft
workforce enables us to optimize our performance and create the best overall value for our
customers. By partnering with Catamaran, you can expect predictable work performance, both on-line
and during outages.

### Deliver Excellence

At Catamaran, we work tirelessly to ensure we exceed our customers' expectations in everything we
do.
Commitment to Safety
Our commitment to creating a safe work environment is evident in everything we do. Our employees are
enabled with Stop Work Authority, creating a culture of accountability on each of our project sites.
Since 2016, we have maintained a 0.0 total recordable incident rate (TRIR).
Responsive & Reliable Service
Catamaran has the labor availability to meet our customers emergent work requirements and the
capacity to complete projects under even the tightest deadlines. In addition, our QA/QC programs are
designed to ensure each project is completed to the highest standards the first time, without latent
defects.
Efficient & Consistent Performance
Catamaran's investment in state-of-the-art equipment combined with our stable, qualified craft
workforce enables us to optimize our performance and create the best overall value for our
customers. By partnering with Catamaran, you can expect predictable work performance, both on-line
and during outages.
Innovative & Flexible Culture
By consistently investing in new ideas and technologies, Catamaran is able to streamline operations
and provide solutions for continuous improvement to our customers. Our adaptable and scalable
project support is a key part of our overall goal of exceeding our customers' expectations.

At Catamaran, we strive to exceed our customers' expectations by providing the highest quality
construction, fabrication, turnaround, maintenance and repair services.

# CharterWorld - The Luxury Yacht Charter Specialist

#### With luxury yacht chartering as our singular focus and passion, CharterWorld create uniquely
#### tailored experiences around the world, where every detail is refined with you in mind.

Our elite global team are seasoned travellers who personally and meticulously inspect yachts so we
can confidently offer guidance and excellence without compromise.

Our boutique approach reflects our heritage of trust and integrity which has been delivering for our
clients for over 25 years. 

## Independent Advice. Exceptional Yachts. Unforgettable Charters. 

**CharterWorld was built around one principle: our loyalty is to the charterer.**
 
Unlike brokerages whose primary role is representing yacht owners, we search the entire charter
market to find the yachts that best match your brief, your budget and your expectations.
 
Our experienced brokers provide independent advice, unbiased recommendations and access to the
world's finest charter yachts—because the best yacht for you isn't always one we represent.
 
That's the difference.

**Welcome to the CharterWorld experience…**

# Cool Catamaran Company Ltd

Registered in England & Wales  ·  Co. No. 15269087

Advanced catamaran design and marine systems development, United Kingdom.

About

Cool Catamaran Company is a UK-based marine development company engaged in the design and build of
high-performance offshore sailing catamarans. Our programmes target CE Category A ocean
classification and are developed in close collaboration with specialist naval architects and
certified marine systems integrators.

The company operates across the full development lifecycle: from initial design and engineering
through to systems integration, sea trials, and delivery. We work with qualified suppliers and
manufacturing partners across Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Australasia, and maintain offices in London
and Brisbane.

Current Programme

Cool Catamaran Company is currently in active development of a 19-metre performance sailing
catamaran targeting CE Category A ocean classification, with a projected completion window of late
2027 to early 2028. The programme encompasses specialist procurement across a broad range of marine
systems and components.

Vessel length 19 metres Classification CE Category A — Ocean Programme status Active development —
supplier qualification phase Target delivery Late 2027 / Early 2028

Active Procurement Categories

Marine propulsion
Electrical architecture
Renewable generation
Auxiliary power
Sail plan & rigging
Navigation & electronics
Deck hardware & systems
Interior fit-out & joinery
Plumbing & sanitation
HVAC systems
Safety & life-saving
Composite materials & laminates
Galley & appliances
Anchoring & mooring
Tender & davit systems
Coatings & antifouling
Supplier & Partner Enquiries

We are actively evaluating qualified manufacturers, distributors, and systems integrators across all
procurement categories. Enquiries are welcomed from established marine suppliers with relevant
certifications, verifiable reference installations, and the capacity to support a CE Category A
programme.

Initial enquiries should be directed to our procurement team. Detailed programme specifications are
shared under a Non-Disclosure Agreement with qualified partners following a preliminary evaluation.

## **They found their suppliers in Bretagne**

*"We are a Hungarian trading company dealing with retail and wholesale of processed seafood and
seaweed products in Central Europe and highlighted in Hungary. We consciously looked for respectful
partners, who can supply us with quality products. In the internet-managed world, it might seem an
easy job to make the first contact at new territories, but it isn't. Fortunately, we have found BCI
a year ago, and it is important to mention personally Mr. Eric Vouland, who helped us a lot in
exploring Bretagne for high quality producers with success! After a year-long trust-based
partnership we have been cooperating with 7 partners from the region and we are just starting a
relation with a brand new one for our common success. Thank you Eric and BCI! We hope that our
fruitful cooperation will continue.”*
**Sandor SZEKELY**
Managing Director - IZTENGER

*"As a start-up which aims to promote international trade between France and South Korea, we called
on the services of BCI in 2019. We were looking for Breton SME interested in the Korean market at
the time. We were pleasantly surprised by the professionalism, the warm welcome and the special
attention of the BCI team. For TAM Global, BCI represents a privileged access to find serious SME
partners in Bretagne. I would highly recommend BCI to my colleagues and Korean clients. So we shall
never be disappointed."*
**‍Thomas KIM**
Managing Director - TAM GLOB

ABOUT US

###### island spirit

# Brief History

The Island Spirit Catamarans brand was introduced into the United States and the Caribbean charter
market in 1998, it instantly became a much sought after catamaran, mainly because of the
revolutionary design which offered both optimal space and superior sailing performance. Over 50
Island Spirits have been built, 35 of which were sold in the United States between 1998 and 2006. To
this day Island Spirit Catamarans are still extremely popular in the second hand market.

The Island Spirit 37 was the first model launched in 1998 followed by the Island Spirit 400 in 2001.
In 2003 Amanzi Marine redesigned and launched the Island Spirit 401. The Island Spirits have been
awarded Top Ten Sail Magazine awards in 2001, 2003 and 2005. In 2003 the boat was also a nominee for
boat of the year.

In 2014 Island Spirit Catamarans moved production to Thailand to provide its customers with the most
competitive pricing while maintaining its highest commitment to quality. The initial model launched
in 2014 was the IS380 which is now in use across Asia in Bareboat Charter Companies, by day trip
operators and a number of personal cruisers.

In 2017, Island Spirit Catamarans launched the first IS410 with models specifically developed for
the bareboat charter operator, the day trip operator and personal cruising. The IS410 to CE
Certified Category A.

**Exciting Milestones of 2024**

In 2024, we gave our beloved **IS 410** a stunning makeover, elevating its design and performance to
new heights. That same year marked the launch of the groundbreaking **IS 525**, our first
electric-powered catamaran, with Hull #1 setting sail as a symbol of innovation and sustainability.

Adding to the excitement, we proudly unveiled our state-of-the-art **manufacturing facility**, a
dedicated space to bring our cutting-edge catamarans to life with unmatched precision and quality.

# Island Spirit 525e Nominated for Cruising World’s Boat of the Year 2026

A proud moment for Island Spirit - the new Island Spirit 525e has been nominated by Cruising World
for Boat of the Year 2026.

Built in Thailand, this 52-foot, fully electric catamaran represents our vision for modern,
sustainable sailing and continues our legacy of innovation at sea.

## Performance. Luxury. Carbon Construction.

#### You only live once. Never compromise.
* ## HH44
  
  The HH44 is an award winning, eco-friendly cruising yacht, designed from the ground up with
  electrification in mind. Redefining what’s possible at this size, the HH44 achieves a new level of
  performance, comfort and style, and is propelling the cruising catamaran market into the future.
  
  [ Learn more ][71]
* ## HH46
  
  The HH46 is the latest iteration of the award winning HH44. Hybrid Eco-Drive and
  carbon/E-glass/epoxy contruction remain standard. Extended transoms, deeper rudders, and updated
  solar and electrical components elevate and future-proof the HH46, which remains the best-in-class
  performance cruising catamaran.
  
  [ Learn more ][72]
* ## HH52
  
  The HH52 is an evolution of the[ award winning HH50][73], featuring a restyled cabin top with
  custom solar array, a new deck plan, new interior layout and increased sail area, the HH52 brings
  the latest design features and performance improvements to our mid-size, luxury cruising
  catamaran.
  
  [ Learn More ][74]
* ## HH56
  
  The all new HH56 represents years of design and product development refinement and the integration
  of new technologies that make cruising more environmentally friendly, safe, and enjoyable. Forward
  helm station, parallel hybrid EcoDrive, 4.5kW of solar, North 3Di Sails and a full suite of
  performance cruising options standard.
  
  [ Learn More ][75]
* ## HH66
  
  Sailing World’s Boat of the Year in 2018, the HH66 is where our journey began. Now with a full
  range of yachts spanning 44 to 88 feet, the HH66 remains our flagship luxury performance cruising
  yacht. Around the buoys or around the world, the HH66 will take you there in style, speed and
  ultimate comfort.
  
  [ Learn More ][76]
* ## HH80
  
  Introducing the extraordinary, all-carbon HH80. Designed to rival the luxury and performance of
  the world’s most magnificent super yachts, the HH80 is ideal for luxurious world cruising or
  thrilling racecourse adventures. Designed by Morrelli and Melvin and customized to meet your
  specific requirements, the HH80 raises the bar and delivers an unrivaled sailing and lifestyle
  experience on the water.
  
  [ Learn More ][77]
* ## HH88
  
  The newly launched HH88 is the second largest carbon fiber catamaran ever built. Fully
  customizable with an optional flybridge, deck level owners’ suite, tiller steering, jacuzzi and
  more. If you can dream it, we can build it.
  
  [ Learn More ][78]

#### itacatamarans

Itacatamarans was founded by Emanuele Caprini an entrepreneur, windsurfer and monohuller, who had
been looking for a sailing catamaran with very specific characteristics in mind.

After having visited various catamaran manufacturers and not having found what he was looking for,
Emanuele decided to create a boatyard to build a catamaran for himself and for other discerning
sailors. That is how Itacatamarans came to be, designing and building superior handcrafted cruising
catamarans which offer exceptional comfort and performance to demanding owners.

## SAIL WITHOUT LIMITS
## LIVE IN COMFORT
## DISTINGUISH YOURSELF WITH ELEGANCE

#### Why itacatamarans

** Elegance, Comfort, Sportiness. Three different souls for an innovative hull, conveyed by elegant
and dynamic lines.** A work of high naval engineering, born from the vision to combine Italian
elegance and attention to detail with the best and most advanced technology. ITA catamarans are
multihulls of excellence, technologically sophisticated, safe and comfortable, redefining the world
of catamarans.

## TOPMOST PERFORMANCES FOR DEMANDING OWNERS

[Discover our construction method][13]

#### SUSTAINABILITY

### From the very onset, for every multihull we build, we give back to the Ocean part of what it
### gives us, involving owners in selecting a project which deals with either remedial actions

### our oceans and our planet.

#### itacatamarans

Itacatamarans was founded by Emanuele Caprini an entrepreneur, windsurfer and monohuller, who had
been looking for a sailing catamaran with very specific characteristics in mind.

After having visited various catamaran manufacturers and not having found what he was looking for,
Emanuele decided to create a boatyard to build a catamaran for himself and for other discerning
sailors. That is how Itacatamarans came to be, designing and building superior handcrafted cruising
catamarans which offer exceptional comfort and performance to demanding owners.

## Who We Are

Brent Vaughan founded Multihull Central in 2013, bringing over 25 years of experience helping new
and seasoned sailors enjoy a seamless and rewarding experience on the world’s best catamarans and
trimarans.

Multihull Central, the leading multihull specialist in the South Pacific region, offers a
comprehensive ecosystem for sailors. We provide accredited catamaran training, onboard charter
experiences, and multiple entry points into catamaran boat ownership. Our expert guidance covers
every stage—from the build process and boat handover through warranty support, after-sales service,
and finally the specialised resale of your prized catamaran.

All of this ensures a fulfilling, life-enhancing journey of island-bound travel — an adventurous and
rewarding escape, well earned after years of hard work.

# International Catamaran & Trimaran Sales

Largest database of Multihulls for sale in the world - By Sailors, For Sailors.

###### Welcome to Multihull World, leading international brokerage for pre-owned and new catamarans
###### and trimarans, with over 100 years of combined experience in our team of passionate sailors
###### and extremely knowledgeable professionals.

As Multihull brokers, we specialise in the sale of Catamarans and Trimarans – so whether you’re
looking to sell your used sailing boat for the best price possible, or want to buy a brand new yacht
from one of the World’s leading manufacturers, Multihull World should be your first port of call.

###### Quality Pre-Owned Catamarans and Trimarans

We are proud to now boast the largest online database of used Catamarans and Trimarans for sale in
the World. From experienced helmsmen to relative newcomers to the sailing World, and everything in
between, our team of passionate sailing experts will help find the right boat for you. Whether you
are looking to embark on a trip around the World or just around the harbour, in a Catamaran or
Trimaran, we have the knowledge and experience to help you choose the right boat from our huge
range.

###### New Catamarans and Trimarans

If you are looking to enjoy the benefits of a new yacht, we offer a fantastic selection from some of
the World’s leading multihull manufacturers. Such is our reputation for customer service, we have
been appointed as sole UK agents for prestigious Catamaran builders Outremer, Broadblue, Gemini and
Maverick. We are also the UK agents for Trimaran builders Corsair Marine.

###### Selling your Multihull?

As leading International Multihull brokers, we can help you sell your boat by listing it within our
database and with our network of brokerage partners. The Multihull World Brokerage Network is the
largest group of multihull specialists in Europe and together we aim to sell your Catamaran or
Trimaran as quickly as possible, but at a price that is right for you.

For more information about our broker services or any of our Catamarans and Trimarans we have for
sale, please call us on [Call us +44(0)1243 377 333][54] or email us at
[sales@multihullworld.co.uk][55]

# Sjøfartsdirektoratet

[

## Ta båtførerprøven

][20]

Dersom du er født i 1980 eller senere og skal føre en fritidsbåt med lengde over 8 meter eller med
motor større enn 25 hestekrefter, må du ha båtførerbevis. Ta kontakt med et godkjent testsenter for
å avtale tidspunkt for prøve.

## Hvilke sider vil du besøke i dag?
* [ Logge inn ][21]
* [ Sjøfartskort ][22]
* [ Maritim radio ][23]
* [ Skipssøket ][24]
* [ Regelverk ][25]
* [ Maritim sikring ][26]
* [ Nullvisjonen ][27]
* [
  
  ## Sjøfolk
  
  ][28]
  
  Om personlige sertifikater, kvalifikasjoner, utdanning, sjøfartsleger, helse, arbeids- og
  levevilkår, velferd og generell info knyttet til besetningen
* [
  
  ## Næringsfartøy
  
  ][29]
  
  Om fartøystyper, utstyr og tekniske krav, tilsyn, sertifikater, tillatelser, dokumenter for fartøy
  og bemanning av skip
* [
  
  ## Skipsregistrene NOR, NIS og BYGG
  
  ][30]
  
  Lær hvordan du registrerer nye fartøy, gjennomfører flaggskifte, overfører eierskap til fartøy,
  registrerer panteheftelser og mer
* [
  
  ## Fritidsbåt
  
  ][31]
  
  Om sertifikater, regelverk, CE-merking, ulykkesstatistikk og godt sjøvett
* [
  
  ## Ulykker, risiko og sikkerhet
  
  ][32]
  
  Innmelding og rapportering av hendelser/ulykker, ulykkesstatistikk, Nullvisjonen,
  ISM/risikovurdering, verne- og miljøarbeid, læring av hendelser, maritim sikring og ISPS
* [
  
  ## Miljø og ny teknologi
  
  ][33]
  
  Om hvordan Sjøfartsdirektoratet arbeider for miljø og utvikling av ny teknologi

# Atemberaubend –
# Europas größte Wasserfälle.

Die unbändige Kraft des Elementes wasser hautnah erleben: Mit einer Fallhöhe von 380 Metern zählen
die Krimmler Wasserfälle zu den eindrucksvollsten Naturschauspielen der Welt.

#### Die Wasserfälle

Die besonders eindrucksvolle Lage am Talausgang, die großen Wassermassen und die außergewöhnlichen
Fallhöhe von 380 m über drei Stufen machen die Krimmler Wasserfälle zu einem beeindruckenden
Naturschauspiel. Sie sind zudem die fünfthöchsten Wasserfälle der Welt.

[mehr erfahren][55]

#### Der Wasserfallweg

Ein vom Österreichischen Alpenverein (ÖAV) geschaffener, 4 km langer Weg führt mit zahlreichen
Aussichtspunkten und Kanzeln hautnah an das Naturschauspiel der Krimmler Wasserfälle heran. In nur
10 – 15 Gehminuten erreicht man vom Parkplatz den untersten Wasserfall.

[hier entdecken][56]

#### MyWaterfalls

Werde Teil der Wasserfall-Community und erzähle Deine schönsten Augenblicke.

Lade deine Bilder bei Instagram hoch und setz den Hashtag
#krimmlerwasserfälle

# Atemberaubend –
# Europas größte Wasserfälle.

Die unbändige Kraft des Elementes wasser hautnah erleben: Mit einer Fallhöhe von 380 Metern zählen
die Krimmler Wasserfälle zu den eindrucksvollsten Naturschauspielen der Welt.

#### Die Wasserfälle

Die besonders eindrucksvolle Lage am Talausgang, die großen Wassermassen und die außergewöhnlichen
Fallhöhe von 380 m über drei Stufen machen die Krimmler Wasserfälle zu einem beeindruckenden
Naturschauspiel. Sie sind zudem die fünfthöchsten Wasserfälle der Welt.

[mehr erfahren][55]

#### Der Wasserfallweg

Ein vom Österreichischen Alpenverein (ÖAV) geschaffener, 4 km langer Weg führt mit zahlreichen
Aussichtspunkten und Kanzeln hautnah an das Naturschauspiel der Krimmler Wasserfälle heran. In nur
10 – 15 Gehminuten erreicht man vom Parkplatz den untersten Wasserfall.

[hier entdecken][56]

Werde Teil der Wasserfall-Community und erzähle Deine schönsten Augenblicke.

# DES CATAMARANS écoresponsables

[DÉCOUVREZ NOTRE GAMME DE CATAMARANS][31]

## DES CATAMARANS pour vous

Chez Windelo, nous concevons des catamarans hauturiers écoresponsables, pensés comme une véritable
expérience de vie en mer : des espaces lumineux et modulables, une circulation fluide, un [cockpit
avant protecteur][32], et un lien naturel entre intérieur et extérieur — pour naviguer loin,
longtemps, en toute sérénité.

Notre approche associe performance sous voiles, autonomie et confort. Grâce à une conception légère
et efficiente, nos catamarans offrent des sensations de navigation authentiques, une belle capacité
de passage et un réel plaisir à la barre, tout en préservant le confort de la vie à bord. 

Notre philosophie est simple : réduire l’empreinte sans renoncer au plaisir. Matériaux plus
responsables, conception raisonnée, motorisation électrique, autonomie énergétique… contribue à une
navigation plus libre, plus silencieuse, plus respectueuse de l’océan.

Et parce que chaque projet est unique, nos catamarans s’adaptent à vos envies grâce à un large choix
de personnalisation et trois univers distincts : [**Adventure**][33] (esprit d’exploration,
simplicité robustesse), [**Yachting**][34] (élégance et confort) et [**Sport**][35] (puissance et
sensations sous voiles).

retrouver, s’isoler, savourer l’instant… sans jamais se sentir à l’étroit.

signature Windelo, il redistribue toute la vie à bord en créant un lieu sûr, abrité et face à la mer
— un espace de veille, de partage, de détente et de navigation, qui transforme la manière de vivre

# DES CATAMARANS écoresponsables

[DÉCOUVREZ NOTRE GAMME DE CATAMARANS][31]

## DES CATAMARANS pour vous

Chez Windelo, nous concevons des catamarans hauturiers écoresponsables, pensés comme une véritable
expérience de vie en mer : des espaces lumineux et modulables, une circulation fluide, un [cockpit
avant protecteur][32], et un lien naturel entre intérieur et extérieur — pour naviguer loin,
longtemps, en toute sérénité.

Notre approche associe performance sous voiles, autonomie et confort. Grâce à une conception légère
et efficiente, nos catamarans offrent des sensations de navigation authentiques, une belle capacité
de passage et un réel plaisir à la barre, tout en préservant le confort de la vie à bord. 

Notre philosophie est simple : réduire l’empreinte sans renoncer au plaisir. Matériaux plus
responsables, conception raisonnée, motorisation électrique, autonomie énergétique… contribue à une
navigation plus libre, plus silencieuse, plus respectueuse de l’océan.

Et parce que chaque projet est unique, nos catamarans s’adaptent à vos envies grâce à un large choix
de personnalisation et trois univers distincts : [**Adventure**][33] (esprit d’exploration,
simplicité robustesse), [**Yachting**][34] (élégance et confort) et [**Sport**][35] (puissance et
sensations sous voiles).

## Windcraft Multihulls is a premier importer, dealer, service provider, and brokerage specializing
## in high-performance trimarans and catamarans. We proudly represent the highly accomplished and
## respected brands Dragonfly Trimarans, Corsair Trimarans, and Seawind Catamarans. Based on the
## beautiful Emerald Coast along the northern Gulf of Mexico in Pensacola, Florida, we serve
## customers throughout the United States.
## 
## There’s something quietly, romantically intoxicating about a performance cruising multihull—the
## way she invites you to slip the dock lines and follow nothing but breeze, horizon, and instinct…
## to truly live. Each hull carries not just performance and craftsmanship, but the promise of
## mornings anchored in still water and evenings spent chasing the last light across an open sea,
## often sailing at windspeed with effortless grace and a feather light helm. This isn’t just
## sailing—it’s a return to freedom: anchoring in less than a meter of water with a deserted beach
## just steps away, waking to a quiet anchorage where the only agenda is fresh fruit, a line in the
## water, and time suspended in the simple joy of being exactly where you belong contemplating your
## next port and envision your multi ripping along elegantly to get there.

## just steps away, waking to a quiet anchorage where the only agenda is fresh fruit, a line in the

## next port and envision your multi ripping along elegantly to get there.

## Charter Destinations

Step aboard on a maritime odyssey in eastern Indonesia, where azure waters and untouched landscapes
beckon adventurous souls. Dive into the enchanting yachting destinations of eastern Indonesia, where
each journey promises a blend of natural beauty and nautical wonders. 

Komodo National Park
Discover the allure of yachting in the mesmerizing Komodo Islands, where a maritime paradise awaits.
This Indonesian gem, renowned for its unique Komodo dragons, also boasts pristine waters and
stunning landscapes that beckon yachting enthusiasts.
[ VIEW MORE ][27]
Raja Ampat
Situated off the north-western coast of Papua, this archipelago comprises over 1,500 islands,
shoals, and cays, with four larger islands at its center. The local waters boast an incredible array
of marine wildlife, earning it a reputation as one of the world's premier diving destinations.
[ VIEW MORE ][28]
BALI, GILI, LOMBOK
These tropical paradises offer crystal-clear waters, vibrant marine life, and picturesque
coastlines. Whether you crave the energy of Bali, the charm of Gili, or the pristine beauty of
Lombok, each destination ensures a unique and unforgettable yachting experience.
[ VIEW MORE ][29]
BANDA ISLANDS
Nestled amidst the Banda Sea, these islands boast a rich maritime history and pristine natural
wonders. Explore secluded anchorages, dive into vibrant coral gardens, and immerse yourself in the
captivating culture of these remote gems.
[ VIEW MORE ][30]
ALOR
Embarking on an extraordinary yachting expedition to Alor in East Indonesia unveils a hidden gem
within the archipelago. Nestled in the Lesser Sunda Islands, Alor promises yachting enthusiasts a
distinctive fusion of untouched beauty and cultural richness.
[ VIEW MORE ][31]

### frequently asked questions

What services does Yacht Sourcing offer?
Yacht Sourcing is your one-stop yachting solution!
We offer yacht sales, construction, charter, management, and central agency services to cater every
aspect of your seamless yachting experience.
What types of yachts do you sell?
We offer a wide range of new and pre-owned yachts, from superyachts, luxury motor yachts to sailing
yachts and performance boats.
Can you help me find a specific type of yacht?
Absolutely! Our experienced team can help you find the perfect yacht to suit your needs and
preferences. We can assist with factors like size, features, and budget.
What brands do you represent?
We are exclusive dealers of Majesty Yachts, Nomad Yachts, Fountaine Pajot, Dufour, Rizzardi, Saxdor,
Yanmar, Al Dhaen, Senous and water toy brand Lift Foils, ensuring you have access to the latest and
most luxurious options.
